scripts.dev: bun run --filter '@nightcrew/web' dev & bun run --filter '@nightcrew/cli' dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@nightcrew/web' build && bun run --filter '@nightcrew/cli' build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/db && tsc -p packages/runner && tsc -p apps/cli && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/site
scripts.site: bun run --filter '@nightcrew/site' build && cd apps/site && bunx vite preview --port 3722 --strictPort
